verdict.rationale: Convex documents that a deployment can run locally for development (convex-docs-53). The CLI watches the filesystem, pushes functions and schema to the dev deployment, and runs functions against it (convex-docs-17, convex-docs-51). The open-source backend, the same code the cloud service uses, can also run on your own machine via Docker or a prebuilt binary (convex-docs-8, convex-gh-3). missing for 10: in-depth docs on the local-deployment workflow beyond a one-line mention, confirmation that every cloud feature (scheduler, file storage, vector search) behaves identically locally, independent hands-on corroboration of local development.
